dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: These two trees look insanely sturdy! The foliage is also surprisingly dense.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Just imagine... how cozy would it be if we could climb up there and take a nap?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: The subtle breeze blowing on the leaves, coupled with the sound of water coming from the fountain... Ah— I swear, I'm feeling sleepy already...
